name: tradew
description: TradeW monorepo — trading platform, AI foundation (ai-core), and premium intelligence products

scripts.//postinstall: @tradew/types, @tradew/ai-core and @tradew/market-data are consumed by their built `main`/`types` (dist/), never their source, and dist/ is gitignored. So a clean checkout resolves none of them: every CI job failed with TS2307 'Cannot find module @tradew/types', and the test job additionally failed with vite's 'Failed to resolve entry for package @tradew/ai-core'. ci.yml built two of the three, but only in the typecheck job — each job gets a fresh runner, so the test job never saw them. Done here, in dependency order, rather than as per-package `prepare` hooks: npm runs those concurrently, so market-data's build started before types had emitted and died on the very error this exists to prevent.
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @tradew/types && npm run build -w @tradew/ai-core && npm run build -w @tradew/market-data
